scope: Offline, lossless real-tool transcript adaptation and narrow pre-freeze v1 citation integration. No sealed benchmark or rubric edits.

checks.command: uv run --project modules\evals ruff check modules\evals
uv run --project modules\evals pytest modules\evals\tests -q -p no:cacheprovider

verified_behaviors: Raw JSON values, URIs, reference IDs and snippets retained without expected-text reconstruction.
Generated synthesis cannot supply missing source evidence.
Full substantive body coverage from a complete chunk or exact observed overlapping chunks.
Missing words, altered passages, wrong namespaces and failed calls fail closed.
Document URI aliases require complete actual body support and unique mappings.
Reference ID aliases require individually complete actual returned references.
Cross-call reused IDs and conflicting same-call IDs remain ambiguous.
Grader rechecks raw hashes, snippet hashes, actual body windows and eligible aliases.
Original response and judge output hash remain unchanged during internal citation lookup.
caveats: Offline replays validate parsing and fail-closed gates, not live model correctness.
JSON hashes do not authenticate tool execution; evaluator-host provenance remains required.
Exact-overlap assembly intentionally rejects unprovable or non-overlapping partial chunks.
Historical validation reports remain intact and describe their earlier code fingerprints.
Synthetic source review requirements and global-pristine versus study-local holdout caveats remain unchanged.
